    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Live Music API - WebSockets API reference<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<p></p>































<aside class="preview"><strong>Preview:</strong><span> The Live Music API is in preview.</span></aside>
<p>Lyria RealTime music generation uses a persistent, bidirectional,
low-latency streaming connection using
<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WebSocket">WebSockets</a>. In this section, you&#39;ll
find additional details regarding the WebSockets API.</p>

<h2 id="sessions" data-text="Sessions" tabindex="-1">Sessions</h2>

<p>A WebSocket connection establishes a session to keep a real-time communication
with the model. After a client initiates a new connection the session can
exchange messages with the server to:</p>

<ul>
<li>Send prompts and controls to steer music generation.</li>
<li>Send music playback controls.</li>
<li>Receive audio chunks.</li>
</ul>

<h3 id="websocket-connection" data-text="WebSocket connection" tabindex="-1">WebSocket connection</h3>

<p>To start a session, connect to this websocket endpoint:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Text only" syntax-guessed><code translate="no" dir="ltr">wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1alpha.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateMusic
</code></pre></devsite-code><aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> The URL is for version <code translate="no" dir="ltr">v1alpha</code>.</span></aside>
<h3 id="session-configuration" data-text="Session configuration" tabindex="-1">Session configuration</h3>

<p>The initial message after connection sets the model to use during the session.</p>

<p>See the following example configuration. Note that the name casing in SDKs may
vary. You can look up the
<a href="https://github.com/googleapis/python-genai/blob/main/google/genai/live_music.py">Python SDK configuration options here</a>.</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre suppresswarning translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code class="prettyprint lang-json" translate="no" dir="ltr">
{
  "model": string
}
</code></pre></devsite-code>

<h2 id="send-messages" data-text="Send messages" tabindex="-1">Send messages</h2>

<p>To exchange messages over the WebSocket connection, the client must send a JSON
object over an open WebSocket connection. The JSON object must have <strong>exactly
one</strong> of the fields from the following object set:</p>

<div></div><devsite-code><pre suppresswarning translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code class="prettyprint lang-json" translate="no" dir="ltr">
{
  "setup": BidiGenerateMusicSetup,
  "client_content": BidiGenerateMusicClientContent,
  "music_generation_config": BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig,
  "playback_control": BidiGenerateMusicPlaybackControl
}
</code></pre></devsite-code>

<h3 id="client-messages" data-text="Supported client messages" tabindex="-1">Supported client messages</h3>

<p>See the supported client messages in the following table:</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Message</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateMusicSetup</code>
</td>
<td>Session configuration to be sent only
in the first message</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateMusicClientContent</code></td>
<td>Weighted prompts as the model input</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig</code></td>
<td>Configuration for music generation</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateMusicPlaybackControl</code>
</td>
<td>Playback control signals for model
generation</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="receive-messages" data-text="Receive messages" tabindex="-1">Receive messages</h2>

<p>To receive messages from the server, listen for the WebSocket &#39;message&#39; event,
and then parse the result according to the definition of the supported server
messages.</p>

<p>See the following:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">def</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nf">receive_audio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">):</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-sd">"""Example background task to process incoming audio."""</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-k">while</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">message</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">in</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">receive</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">():</span>
      <span class="devsite-syntax-n">audio_data</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">message</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">server_content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">audio_chunks</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">0</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">data</span>
      <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Process audio...</span>
      <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">asyncio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">sleep</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">10</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">**-</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">12</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">with</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">aio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">music</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">connect</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'models/lyria-realtime-exp'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-n">asyncio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">TaskGroup</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tg</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">):</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Set up task to receive server messages.</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tg</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create_task</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">receive_audio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">))</span>

  <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Send initial prompts and config</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">set_weighted_prompts</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">prompts</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
      <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">WeightedPrompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'minimal techno'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">weight</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mf">1.0</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">),</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">set_music_generation_config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">LiveMusicGenerationConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">bpm</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">90</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">temperature</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mf">1.0</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

  <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Start streaming music</span>
  <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">play</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Server messages include <strong>exactly one</strong> of the other fields from the
<a href="#BidiGenerateMusicServerMessage"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateMusicServerMessage</code></a> message.
(The <code translate="no" dir="ltr">messageType</code> union is not expressed in JSON so the field will appear at
the top-level of the message.)</p>

<h2 id="messages" data-text="Messages and events" tabindex="-1">Messages and events</h2>

<section id="AudioChunk">
  <h3 id="audiochunk" data-text="AudioChunk" tabindex="-1">AudioChunk</h3>

  <section id="AudioChunk.description">
    <p>Representation of an audio chunk.</p>
  </section>
  <section id="AudioChunk.FIELDS">
    <table class="properties responsive fixed" id="AudioChunk.FIELDS-table">
      <colgroup>
        <col width="25%" />
        <col />
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th colspan="2">Fields</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr id="AudioChunk.FIELDS.oneof_content" class="alt">
          <td colspan="2">
            <p>Union field <code translate="no" dir="ltr">content</code>.</p>
            <p><code translate="no" dir="ltr">content</code> can be only one of the following:</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AudioChunk.FIELDS.bytes.AudioChunk.data">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">data</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bytes</code></p>
            <p>Raw bytes of the audio chunk.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AudioChunk.FIELDS.string.AudioChunk.mime_type">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">mimeType</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></p>
            <p>The MIME type of the content of the audio chunk, such as "audio/wav".</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="AudioChunk.FIELDS.AudioChunk.SourceMetadata.AudioChunk.source_metadata">
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">sourceMetadata</code></td>
          <td>
            <p>
              <code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#AudioChunk.SourceMetadata">SourceMetadata</a></code>
            </p>
            <p>Output only. Prompts and config used for generating this audio chunk.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </section>
</section>

<section id="AudioChunk.SourceMetadata">
  <h3 id="sourcemetadata" data-text="SourceMetadata" tabindex="-1">SourceMetadata</h3>

<section id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig">

        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.float.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.temperature"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">temperature</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">float</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Controls the variance in audio generation.</p>
            <p>Higher values produce higher variance. Range is [0.0, 3.0]. Default is 1.1.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.int32.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.top_k"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">topK</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">int32</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Controls how the model selects tokens for output.</p>
            <p>
              Samples the topK tokens with the highest probabilities. Range is [1, 1000]. Default is
              40.
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.int32.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.seed"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">seed</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">int32</code></p>
            <p>
              Optional. Seeds audio generation. If not set, the request uses a randomly generated
              seed.
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.float.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.guidance"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">guidance</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">float</code></p>
            <p>
              Optional. Controls how closely the model follows prompts. Higher guidance follows more
              closely, but will make transitions more abrupt. Range is [0.0, 6.0]. Default is 4.0.
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.int32.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.bpm"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">bpm</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">int32</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Beats per minute. Range is [60, 200].</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.float.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.density"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">density</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">float</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Density of sounds. Range is [0.0, 1.0].</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.float.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.brightness"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">brightness</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">float</code></p>
            <p>Optional. Higher value produces brighter audio. Range is [0.0, 1.0].</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.Scale.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.scale"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">scale</code></td>
          <td>
            <p>
              <code class="apitype"
                 translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="#BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.Scale">Scale</a></code
              >
            </p>
            <p>Optional. Scale of the generated music.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.mute_bass"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">muteBass</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. The audio output should not contain bass.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.mute_drums"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">muteDrums</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. The audio output should not contain drums.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.only_bass_and_drums"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">onlyBassAndDrums</code></td>
          <td>
            <p><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">bool</code></p>
            <p>Optional. The audio output should only contain bass and drums.</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr
          id="BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.FIELDS.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.MusicGenerationMode.BidiGenerateMusicGenerationConfig.music_generation_mode"
        >
          <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">musicGenerationMode</code></td>

              <code class="apitype"

              >

<section id="BidiGenerateMusicServerContent">

  <section id="BidiGenerateMusicServerContent.description">
    <p>Incremental server update generated by the model in response to client messages.</p>
    <p>
      Content is generated as quickly as possible, and not in real time. Clients may choose to
      buffer and play it out in real time.
    </p>
